title: symphyotrichum anticostense
intro: Symphyotrichum anticostense, commonly known as Eastern purple coneflower, is a perennial flowering plant in the daisy family. It is native to eastern North America and has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The plant is believed to have therapeutic actions such as soothing irritated tissues, reducing fever, and promoting wound healing. Bioactive constituents of Symphyotrichum anticostense include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
